name: Word Hunt
description: Sealed-tick competitive word-guessing. Both players race to guess the SAME secret word of the configured length (4, 5, or 6 letters). Each round, both players submit a guess sealed (neither sees the other's until both have submitted), then their per-letter feedback is revealed (Green = right letter, right position; Yellow = in word, wrong position; Gray = not in word). First to solve wins the game; same-round double-solve = tied game; neither solves in `max_guesses` = tied game. Configurable: best-of-N match length (1/3/5/7 games; default 1 = single game) and number of guesses per game (default 6). Chat is DISABLED — players don't see each other's reasoning, only the abstract notification 'opponent submitted'.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Both players submit one guess per round. Round resolves when both have submitted.

entity_types.name: WordleDuelPlayer
entity_types.description: A Wordle Duel player. Reads their own grid of past guesses + feedback, submits the next guess of the configured word length.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Seat: 'white' (first-listed) or 'black' (second). Both players are equally active each round — color is purely a tag.

properties.name: guesses_used
properties.description: Number of guesses this player has made.

properties.name: solved
properties.description: True after this player's most recent guess matched the target.

properties.name: vocabulary_breadth
properties.description: 0 = sticks to common words; 1 = reaches for uncommon vocab.

properties.name: info_seeking
properties.description: 0 = always tries to solve outright with each guess; 1 = uses early guesses to maximize letter information (e.g. AUDIO, OATEN, etc).

actions.name: submit_guess
actions.description: Submit your guess for the current round. REQUIRED parameter `guess` — an alphabetic word matching the configured word length in your current game instructions (case-insensitive; quotes, hyphens, and non-letters are stripped automatically). Sealed: your opponent does NOT see what you guessed until both players have submitted. After both submit, both grids reveal feedback simultaneously.

parameters.name: guess
parameters.description: A word matching the configured word length to guess (any letters a-z; not required to be in a dictionary).

agent_archetypes.name: Info Maxer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays the optimal first-guess theory — uses early guesses to maximize letter-information (vowel-heavy words like AUDIO, OUIJA, OATEN). Switches to solving only when the residual set of candidates is small.

agent_archetypes.name: Common-Word Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Sticks to common, frequent words. Picks plausible candidates from the start, doesn't 'waste' a guess on rare-letter probes. Wins by going fast on common targets, loses on obscure ones.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hybrid — first guess maximizes info, second narrows, third onward tries to solve. Adapts based on how many letters the opening probe locked in.

agent_archetypes.name: Risk-Taker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Goes for the solve early — if even one or two letters look right, commits to a candidate fitting them rather than probing further. Wins fast or burns guesses on misses.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.max_guesses
runtime_parameters.label: Max guesses per game
runtime_parameters.description: How many guesses each player gets per game. Standard Wordle is 6. Lower = punishing; higher = leans toward a draw on hard words.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.word_length
runtime_parameters.label: Word length
runtime_parameters.description: Number of letters in the target word. 4 = quick & breezy, 5 = classic Wordle, 6 = harder & more diagnostic openers.

runtime_parameters.name: wins_needed
runtime_parameters.label: Games to Win Match
runtime_parameters.description: Games a player must win to take the match. 1 = best of 1, 2 = best of 3, 3 = best of 5. Draws are replayed.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'speed-solve tournament' or 'word-game championship'.

termination_conditions.name: solved_win
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player solves the word.

termination_conditions.name: draw
termination_conditions.description: End the game on a draw (both solved same round, or both exhausted guesses).
